name: Row

props.name: condensed
props.description: Specify a single row as condensed.Rows that are adjacent and are condensed will have 2px of margin between them to match gutter.

props.name: narrow
props.description: Specify a single row as narrow. The container will hang 16px into the gutter.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Row rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
